limitations: Only nondegenerate symmetric forms in odd characteristic; mutual zero products, not all commuting tuples; no conjugacy refinement or nonreduced scheme determination.
scientific_integrity: Finite checks directly evaluate the original multiplication identities; proof treats all odd prime powers, dimensions at least two and all tuple lengths. External historical priority and independent validation are not claimed.
title: Joint ranks and common images of mutually annihilating self-adjoint square-zero operators
